description: This PHP class defines a console command named 'debug:event-dispatcher' that uses the Symfony Console component to display registered event listeners and their priorities within the OrangeHRM system's event dispatcher framework. It initializes a framework kernel, creates a request, and outputs the event listeners in a table format for debugging purposes.

classes.name: EventDispatcherDebugCommand
classes.description: Provides a console command to debug and display the event listeners and their priorities registered in the system.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SymfonyStyle output interface for formatted console output.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles the core logic of retrieving event listeners, their priorities, and outputting them in a table for debugging.
